title: The phone-number backup is recorded as released on 25 Nov, but no app with it has gone out
what: The newest What's new entry and the server change both say 'phone number sign-in also keeps your workouts safe' went out on 25 Nov. The server half is live, but no new app was released: Google Play, the app's own news file and the newest GitHub release all still show 0.79.0 a day later. Phone number is the main way to sign in, so every member who signed in that way still has no copy of their workouts on MettleUp's server and loses them with the phone, while the notes say this is fixed.
expected: A feature is recorded as released only once the app version holding it is on Google Play; until then the notes say it is waiting for release.
fix_line: Release 0.80.0 to Google Play production, or mark the 25 Nov notes as waiting for release
